blocks.text: Allaah's Name Al-Hakeem The All-Wise is found in the Qur'aan nearly a hundred times. Allaah said,
And He is the Irresistible, above His slaves, and He is the All-Wise, Well-Acquainted with all things.

This great Name affirms perfect rule for Allaah and perfect wisdom. As for perfect wisdom, then it is affirmation of wisdom for Allaah in His creation, command and legislation, where He places things in their rightful places and in their correct station. No one directs a question or voices criticism of His wisdom.
As for perfect rule, it is affirmation of rule for Allaah alone. He rules between His servants with what He wishes. He decrees for them what He wills. Nothing can repel His rule or change His decree.
The decision is only for Allah.
and He makes none to share in His Decision and His Rule.
No one can ask for reconsideration of Allaah's Rule like people do amongst themselves in their rulings.
And Allah judges, there is none to put back His Judgement and He is Swift at reckoning.
His rule in His creation is applied with no one to repel or change it.

Affirming rule for Allaah comprises affirmation of all Allaah's Beautiful Names and Lofty Attributes because Allaah is not a Ruler except that He Hears, Sees, Knows, is All-Aware, Speaks, Directs affairs and so on from His Names and Attributes.

keyPoints: Al-Hakeem is found in the Qur'aan nearly a hundred times.
This Name affirms two things for Allaah: perfect rule and perfect wisdom.
Perfect wisdom means Allaah places things in their rightful places and correct station in His creation, command and legislation, and no one directs a question or criticism at His wisdom.
Perfect rule means rule belongs to Allaah alone; nothing can repel His rule or change His decree, and no one can ask for reconsideration of it.
Affirming rule for Allaah comprises affirming all His Names and Attributes, because He is not a Ruler except that He Hears, Sees, Knows, Speaks and directs affairs.

evidence.text: And He is the Irresistible, above His slaves, and He is the All-Wise, Well-Acquainted with all things.
And Allah judges, there is none to put back His Judgement and He is Swift at reckoning.

recall.a: The All-Wise; the Name affirms for Allaah perfect rule and perfect wisdom.

recall.q: How often is Al-Hakeem found in the Qur'aan?
What is meant by affirming perfect wisdom for Allaah?
recall.a: Affirming wisdom for Him in His creation, command and legislation, where He places things in their rightful places and correct station; no one directs a question or criticism at His wisdom.

recall.q: Why does affirming rule for Allaah comprise affirming all His Names and Attributes?
recall.a: Because Allaah is not a Ruler except that He Hears, Sees, Knows, is All-Aware, Speaks, Directs affairs and so on from His Names and Attributes.
